name: Yoneda Hikari
source:
2nd year Business Administrations student.
The softhearted one at the boarding house.
He has no sense for cooking so he's the type that is easily attracted with food being cooked for him.
He doesn't always seem to get along with people and can get disappointed.
But he's an optimist and his mood can quickly turn around.
translation:
2nd year Business Administrations student.
The softhearted one at the boarding house.
He has no sense for cooking so he's the type that is easily attracted with food being cooked for him.
He doesn't always seem to get along with people and can get disappointed.
But he's an optimist and his mood can quickly turn around.
